findings.title: Findings
findings.subtitle: What the scans found and where each case stands

filters.title: Filters
filters.stateHint: With none checked, all states are shown.
filters.searchHint: Part of the path, signature name or full SHA-256.
filters.runHint: Run identifier, as shown in Runs.

findings.endOfList: All findings matching these filters are listed.
findings.emptyOpenDescription: No scan found anything that needs attention. To review closed cases, show all states.
findings.emptyFilteredDescription: Adjust or clear the filters to see other findings.

detail.notFoundDescription: The address does not match any finding. Go back to the list and search again.
detail.author: Author
detail.locationsEmpty: No file is linked to this finding.

transition.title: Change state
transition.hint: The options depend on the current state.
transition.noteHint: Explain the decision for whoever reviews it later. It goes into the history.
transition.noteMissing: Write a note explaining the decision.
transition.none: No manual change is available from this state.
transition.readOnly: Your role can view findings but not change their state.
transition.exceptedHint: To cover it by an exception, use “Create exception”: it asks for a reason and an expiry.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.subtitle: Reviewed findings that no longer need attention, always with a reason and, when possible, an expiry
exceptions.fromFinding: Filled in from finding #{{id}}. Check what it will cover.

scopeName.rule_global: This rule on the whole server

scopeHelp.hash: Ignores any file with this same content, under any rule. If the content changes, the exception stops applying.
scopeHelp.hash_rule: Ignores only this rule on this exact content. Other rules still apply, and the exception stops applying if the content changes.
scopeHelp.rule_prefix: Ignores this rule on every file in the directory and its subdirectories. Requires an expiry.
scopeHelp.rule_global: Ignores this rule anywhere on the server. Only an administrator can create it.

exceptions.noHash: Unavailable: this finding has no SHA-256
exceptions.signatureHint: Exact signature name, as shown on the finding.
exceptions.pathPrefixHint: Absolute path, such as /home/shop/public_html/cache. The root (/) is not accepted.
exceptions.reasonHint: Why this is not a problem. It goes into the finding history and the audit log.
exceptions.validityHint: When it expires, the findings show up again on the next scan that detects them.
exceptions.effect: Once created, the new or under-review findings it covers become “Covered by exception”. Confirmed findings do not change.
exceptions.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields before continuing.
exceptions.confirmImpact: The new or under-review findings it covers become “Covered by exception” now, and identical new detections stop needing attention while it is valid.

errors.scopeAdminOnly: Only an administrator can create a server-wide exception.
errors.sha256Invalid: Enter the full SHA-256: 64 characters from 0 to 9 and a to f.
errors.signatureTooLong: The signature is longer than 256 characters.
errors.pathPrefixInvalid: Enter an absolute directory (starting with /) other than the root.
errors.pathPrefixTooLong: The directory is longer than 4096 characters.
errors.reasonTooLong: The reason is longer than 2000 characters.
errors.validityRequired: A directory exception needs an expiry.

exceptions.caption: Registered exceptions
exceptions.revokeImpact: The exception stops applying now. The findings it covered go back to “New” on the next scan that detects them.
exceptions.emptyDescription: To create one, open a reviewed finding and use “Create exception”, or use “New exception”.
exceptions.readOnly: Your role can view exceptions but not create or revoke them.
